title: Rectangular bar
spec: Create a new coordinate system with Euler angles set to zero and a translation vector also set to zero. For the first face, draw a loop consisting of four lines: start from the origin (0.0, 0.0) and draw a line to (0.0757, 0.0), then to (0.071, 0.01), next to (0.0047, 0.01), and finally back to the origin. For the second face, draw another loop starting from (0.071, 0.01) to (0.0757, 0.0), then to (0.7462, 0.0), next to (0.75, 0.01), and finally back to (0.071, 0.01). Apply a scale factor of 0.75 to the entire two-dimensional sketch. Transform the scaled two-dimensional sketch into three dimensions without any additional transformations since the Euler angles and translation vector are already set to zero. Extrude the sketch 0.1402 units along the normal direction, ensuring that the extrusion does not occur in the opposite direction. Ensure the extruded part forms a new solid body. The final dimensions of the rectangular bar will be 0.7499999996491369 units in length, 0.010014528093481545 units in width, and 0.14020339330874163 units in height.

reference.label: Reference (dataset)
reference.code:
import cadquery as cq

# Create a new workplane
r = cq.Workplane("XY")

# Define the sketch for the first face
r = r.moveTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.0757, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.071, 0.01) \
     .lineTo(0.0047, 0.01) \
     .lineTo(0.0, 0.0) \
     .close()

# Define the sketch for the second face
r = r.moveTo(0.071, 0.01) \
     .lineTo(0.0757, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.7462, 0.0) \
     .lineTo(0.75, 0.01) \
     .lineTo(0.071, 0.01) \
     .close()

# Extrude the sketch to create the rectangular bar
r = r.extrude(0.1402)

# The final model is represented as 'r'
